name: Disting MIDI Breakout
source: https://www.expert-sleepers.co.uk/dm4midibreakout.html ; disting_user_manual_4.17.pdf p.109 (MIDI I/O, breakout module); ModularGrid panel image (checked 21 Oct 2026)
notes: Passive 4HP breakout exposing the host module's MIDI in/out header as two 5-pin DIN sockets (disting manual: header carries one MIDI input and one MIDI output). Works with disting mk4/EX, ES-9, General CV, FH-2, CVM-8. Exact printed labels and panel photo not seen.
